fact: At a 20 February 2026 workshop in Gitega, the Interior ministry's permanent secretary said results in the twelve E-TAXE pilot communes (running since 23 August 2024) show traceability of revenue and centralisation of data, and that national extension is being prepared with CRDB bank terminals.
title: Communes Bubanza, Bukinanyana, Kayanza, Ngozi, Kirundo, Muyinga, Cankuzo, Ruyigi, Rutana, Gitega, Makamba et Nyanza: pilotes pour la digitalisation fiscale E-TAXE, un tournant majeur pour la gestion des recettes communales
